story: A three-man breakaway with Engelhardt, Van den Broek, and Molenaar was caught at the local circuit. UAE Team Emirates - XRG controlled the peloton, with the local climb causing a selection. Isaac del Toro led out the group of favorites, but did it in such fashion that only Pogačar could stay in his wheel. Pogačar slowed down, handing his Mexican teammate the win.
